maria-s: Heads up — customer jackson-prod is getting 504s and 502s on the hosted inference endpoint during a burst at ~10:14 UTC. Seen across 3 regions.

support-lee: Reported by CS via ticket #123456, customer repro steps attached. They hit ~200 concurrent requests, most short seq_len.

customer-jackson: Repro steps: send 200 concurrent POSTs to /v1/generate with text prompt ~128 tokens. Some return 504 after ~30s. We used us-east-1 endpoint.

sre_jordan: Looking at gateway logs now. I see long queue times 20-40s then upstream 502 from inference-proxy.

sre_jordan: snippet from proxy log: ```[2025-11-02T10:14:32Z] tenant=jackson-prod route=/v1/generate queue_wait=35210ms upstream_status=502 backend=node-az1-7 ready=false```

maria-s: @david-ops can you check autoscaler = HPA + KEDA config for jackson-prod? Suspect scale-up lag / readiness.

david-ops: On it. HPA target looks fine, but ScaledObject has cooldown 120s and activationThreshold=50. For this traffic we might be below activation briefly then spike. I also see warmupDelay for prewarm containers = 30s.

david-ops: Running `kubectl describe scaledobject jackson-prod` shows: ```cooldownPeriod: 120s\ntrigger: queueLength\nactivationThreshold: 50\nmaxReplicaCount: 20```

support-lee: Customer says errors start within 5s of burst — that fits warmup lag where scale decision doesn't catch microbursts.

eng-runtime-ana: If the runtime takes ~20s to initialize the model (cold start) that combined with KEDA/HPA cooldown could generate the 504 window. Are pods failing readiness probes initially?

david-ops: Readiness shows transient failures: `readiness probe failed: startup not complete` and pod init time ~22-28s. Liveness fine.

sre_jordan: We also have evidence of backpressure: queue depth grows then KEDA scaler sees metric jitter and only adds 2 pods, but requests keep arriving -> queue overflow -> gateway returns 502/504.

maria-s: Immediate mitigation options?

eng-runtime-ana: Short-term: increase ScaledObject activationThreshold to 10 and reduce cooldown to 20s? Also set minReplicaCount=2 for jackson-prod to ensure baseline capacity.

support-lee: Customer is OK with a brief change while we patch. I'll ask for permission to touch their tenant config.

david-ops: Patching now: `kubectl patch scaledobject jackson-prod --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicaCount":2,"cooldownPeriod":20,"activationThreshold":10}}'`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: ScaledObject/jackson-prod patched by david-ops at 2025-11-02T10:22:11Z :rocket:

sre_jordan: Observing metrics — queue depth drops within 30s, 5xx rate decreases. A few 504s remain during pod init windows.

customer-jackson: We're seeing much fewer errors now, thank you. Still occasional 504s during peak but overall better.

maria-s: Need root cause and long-term fix. Hypothesis: KEDA activationThreshold + long model init time + coldstart readiness probe timing = race that leaves gateway to time out. Also some tenants have bursty patterns that never hit activationThreshold.

eng-runtime-ana: Agreed. Long-term options: 1) Pre-warm pools per-tenant (background warmups) 2) Improve runtime model init (lazy load parts, reduce init time) 3) Change KEDA scaling metric to rps or queue-per-replica rather than raw queue length 4) Add staged readiness: advertise instance ready earlier and buffer early tokens via prefix caching.

david-ops: For immediate safety we should default minReplicaCount=1 for all prod tenants and add an alert when scaledobject has cooldown>60s for high-throughput tenants.

support-lee: Filing follow up ticket for product to evaluate prewarm & metric change. CS will notify customer of mitigation steps and timeline.

maria-s: For postmortem: capture timeline, customer impact, config that caused it, mitigation, planned follow-ups. Assign owners: eng-runtime-ana (root cause + runtime improvements), eng-platform-david-ops (scaling config defaults + automation), support-lee (customer comms).

eng-runtime-ana: I'll start a small experiment to switch scaler metric to requests_per_second and test in staging with synthetic bursts.

sre_jordan: Adding logs and grafana dashboard links: https://grafana.internal/redwood/tenant/jackson-prod?from=1769001000&to=1769008000

customer-jackson: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please keep us posted.

maria-s: Closing thread for incident timeline — will open postmortem doc and link here. :white_check_mark:

support-lee: Postmortem doc: https://confluence.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-2025-11-02-keda-handoff-backpressure
